maria_devex: Heads-up - support got two tickets where the console quota view flashed another org's numbers for a sec after the v2 rollout.
jake_eng_platform: can you drop repro? which endpoint and tab?
maria_devex: steps: signin as org-alpha -> Console -> Settings -> Quotas -> per-route. Refresh a few times. ~2% of loads showed org-bravo committed numbers. Quick screenshot attached in ticket.
sophia_prod: looking at traces: some /internal/tenant-quota responses include a response.org_id that doesn't match the request cookie.org_id. pattern suggests cache serving stale org payload.
liam_oncall: this aligns with route-prefetch v2 flip last night (sticky per-connection meta + new cache-keying). Did we change cache key composition?
deploy-bot: deploy finished: route-prefetch v2 @ 2025-01-18T04:12:01Z :white_check_mark:
ranjit_sre: gateway logs show same TCP conn handling requests for different orgs quickly; we introduced sticky_meta on conn level. snippet:
ranjit_sre: ```
[2025-01-18T04:12:07Z] conn=900 req=88 route=/internal/tenant-quota cookie.OrgId=org-alpha X-Org-Override=org-alpha
[2025-01-18T04:12:08Z] conn=900 req=89 route=/internal/prefetch key=route:billing sticky_meta=org-bravo
[2025-01-18T04:12:09Z] conn=900 req=90 route=/internal/tenant-quota cookie.OrgId=org-alpha X-Org-Override=org-alpha cached_key=route:billing -> payload(org-bravo)
```
jake_eng_platform: ah. prefetch is seeding connection-scoped cache entries with sticky_meta; later quota request uses cached entry without re-applying per-request header. bad.
maria_devex: that explains UI flash: console parallel prefetch + quota call race.
liam_oncall: short-term mitigation: reset/ignore sticky conn metadata for internal tenant-scoped endpoints, or canonicalize X-Org-Override from cookie at gateway entry for those paths.
ranjit_sre: i'm preparing a rollback/patch: (1) roll prefetch back to v1 on canary nodes (2) add gateway assertion that X-Org-Override == cookie.OrgId for /internal/tenant* calls (3) change cache-key to include explicit org id.
jake_eng_platform: also make cache-keying deterministic: do not compress org into connection sticky bits. include org_id in key and in prefetched artifact metadata.
sophia_prod: add telemetry: quota responses should include headers cache_origin=(direct|prefetch) and response.org_id; we'll add an Optimize regression that alerts when response.org_id != cookie.OrgId more than 0 times per minute.
maria_devex: for console UX: during rollout changes that affect routing/cache keys, we should surface a "data consistency migration" indicator and temporarily grey out per-route aggregates to avoid misleading displays.
liam_oncall: for immediate relief, can we linearize console prefetch: avoid firing parallel prefetch and quota calls on same session during rollout windows? serialization lowers cross-seed risk.
jake_eng_platform: easy change on the console side; i'll do a small PR to add a session mutex around prefetch during the rollout flag.
ranjit_sre: rollback started on canary: route-prefetch v2 -> v1 on us-west-2 nodes. monitoring for assertion spikes.
rollback-bot: rollback initiated: route-prefetch -> previous stable @ 2025-01-18T04:22:30Z
liam_oncall: runbook update: if gateway assertion rate > 0.05% over 5m, pause all prefetch gradients and escalate.
sophia_prod: adding an e2e that asserts quota panel requests include X-Org-Override matching cookie per request. also instrument to log cache_origin.
maria_devex: i've drafted a short customer note for CS explaining a transient UI inconsistency during the canary - offered to follow up if they saw actual quota enforcement issues (none so far).
jake_eng_platform: plan of attack: PR1: include org_id into cache key (small, infra-level). PR2: gateway assert + canonicalize header (low-risk). PR3: console serialization fallback for rollout. PR4: telemetry alert. We'll gate PR1/2 behind a canary test.
ranjit_sre: assigning rollback + gateway patch to me: action/1763344666
liam_oncall: i'll monitor SLOs and the new regression alert. if we see repeated mis-attribution, we'll open a Sev.
sophia_prod: noted. adding regression alert and a dashboard tile for cookie_vs_response_org mismatch.
maria_devex: thanks all. reconvene in 25m in #eng-platform with status. :thumbsup:
